meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning skill. Self-orchestrates 5 hostile category members (unspecified-low, unspecified-high, deep, ultrabrain, artistry) via team-mode for ruthless cross-critique debate, distills only the defensible insights, then MANDATORILY hands the distilled insight bundle to the `plan` agent for executable plan formalization. Use when planning needs maximum rigor and surfacing of weak assumptions, blind spots, and over-engineering. Triggers: 'hyperplan', 'hpp', '/hyperplan', 'adversarial plan', 'hostile planning', 'cross-critique plan', '하이퍼플랜', '적대적 계획', '교차 비평'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用多智能体对抗辩论提炼规划洞察，生成可执行方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在规划时暴露弱假设并避免盲点
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to surface weak assumptions and blind spots in your planning process

howto.what: 装上后,当你需要做规划时,Claude 会组建一个由 5 个互相敌对成员组成的团队,让他们互相批判,只保留经得起攻击的洞察,再交给专门的规划智能体形成执行计划。
howto.when: 当你说出“hyperplan”等触发词,或提出需要严格审视假设、盲点和过度设计的规划请求时,技能会接管。

say.text: hyperplan:分析这个功能需求的假设和盲点。
say.note: 会启动对抗性审查小组。

say.text: 用对抗性规划,批判性地审查我的项目计划。
say.note: 进入对抗模式,5 名成员互批后给出计划。

say.text: 交叉批评这个方案:找出过度设计和薄弱假设。
say.note: 将触发对抗批评并提炼出可执行计划。

howto.what_en: When planning is needed, Claude spawns a 5-member adversarial team to critique each other, keeps only surviving insights, and hands them to a dedicated planner for an executable plan.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say 'hyperplan' or other trigger words, or when your planning request needs rigorous scrutiny of assumptions, blind spots, and over-engineering.

say_en.text: hyperplan: analyze the assumptions and blind spots of this feature requirement.
Use adversarial planning to critically review my project plan.
say_en.note: Enters hostile mode; 5 members critique and produce a plan.

say_en.text: Cross-critique this proposal: find over-engineering and weak assumptions.
say_en.note: Triggers adversarial critique and distills a plan.
